title: ISRO URSC Apprentice Online Form 2026
organization: U R Rao Satellite Centre (URSC), ISRO Bengaluru
postName: Graduate Apprentice Trainee & Diploma Apprentice Trainee (Advt. URSC:03:2026)
vacancyDetails: 410 one-year apprentice training posts: Graduate Apprentice, Technician (Diploma) and Diploma in Commercial Practice streams
qualification: Graduate degree / Diploma in relevant engineering or commercial practice disciplines as per URSC Advt July 2026
ageLimit: As per Apprentices Act / URSC apprentice advertisement
selectionProcess: Online Application (NATS + UMANG) → Merit / Shortlist → Document Verification → Apprenticeship Engagement
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, degree/diploma certificates, consolidated marksheets, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Register on NATS portal https://nats.education.gov.in
2. Apply via UMANG portal – search URSC Apprenticeship
3. Upload certificates within size limits
4. Submit between 29 July 2026 and 28 August 2026
5. Keep email ID unique – only one application per email
shortDescription: ISRO URSC Apprentice Online Form 2026 for 410 Graduate/Diploma trainee posts. Apply 29 July–28 August 2026 via NATS and UMANG. No fee.
content:
U R Rao Satellite Centre (URSC), ISRO Bengaluru has released Advt. URSC:03:2026 for engagement of Graduate and Diploma Apprentice Trainees.

Total posts: 410. Online registration: 29 July 2026 (12:00 hrs) to 28 August 2026 (23:59 hrs).

How to apply

  • First enroll on NATS (nats.education.gov.in)
  • Then apply through UMANG for URSC Apprenticeship
  • No application fee

Notification PDF is available on isro.gov.in. This is apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act—not a regular ISRO employment guarantee.
